items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: Like Parence, let me see who was that band. I'm trying to think who was that band. But I used to probably a fellow by the name of Billy Phillips used to play that accordion.

ctx.x: Well they did it a couple times. World War I. No, but this was permanent. Yeah, that was in 1917. Yeah. Mr. Charles, we wanted to ask you about the use of the accordion in these jazz groups that you played with. When did you use it?

Well I used that, not me, but the bands I played with. Like Parence, let me see who was that band. I'm trying to think who was that band. But I used to probably a fellow by the name of Billy Phillips used to play that accordion. And I mean he sure would play that accordion.
But you didn't use it much then?
